events.text: A2 here. I know the safe doors for gate 2 (right) and gate 4 (left). I do not know gate 1's safe door, so I won't guess. Whoever knows gate 1 (or gate 3 or 5), please post it. I'm running look_around first to see if it reveals anything about gate 1.
